items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: we didn't know him nothing else but by Red... we got to know him whenever he'd come, he'd always talk with us... I asked him about taking my place in the band

ctx.x: Oh, when you quit, who did you give your music to? What did you give him?

Followed by the name of, we didn't know him nothing else but by Red. He didn't live here. He used to go, every year he'd come through on a cycle, see, like that. And we got to know him whenever he'd come, he'd always talk with us. So last time, before I stopped playing, he came through and I wanted to quit because I began to get pyreia, you know. And I asked him about taking my place in the band. And he said that he had to go to Tulsa, Oklahoma. That's where this band, the Psych is at. And he would write me when…
I'm afraid it's about to run out now.
